rawIdentityContract.serialization: recursive JSON-compatible canonical serialization with lexicographically sorted object keys and preserved array order

seedConservationContract.pendingRole: captured seeds removed from board but not re-materialized before terminal return remain represented in pending

population.type: exhaustive reconstructed raw-state graph plus separate immutable repository-row binding target
population.rootSource: regenerate frozen REWR reachability witness from standard initial state

gates.A-G1: all frozen source and Stage 2 candidate-contract hashes match exactly
gates.A-G2: frozen reachability witness regenerates the exact frozen raw root key
gates.A-G3: production and independent implementations reconstruct the same complete raw state and transition sets
gates.A-G5: production and independent canonical raw serializations and state keys agree for every reconstructed state
gates.A-G6: every reconstructed state represents exactly 64 seeds under the frozen formula
gates.A-G7: terminal transitions preserve winner semantics and captured/pending accounting under both implementations
gates.A-G8: every repository-facing stored row, without correction, re-hashes to its stored stateKey under both strict serializers
gates.A-G9: every repository-facing stateKey binds one-to-one to the corresponding reconstructed raw state with exact identity-field equality
gates.A-G10: every nonterminal repository/reconstructed source and exact legal move resolves to the same frozen successor raw key
gates.A-G11: IDENTITY preserves exact state identity, move/transition identity, terminal semantics and repository-oracle reconstruction with zero mismatch
gates.A-G12: production and independent implementations agree exactly on graph, serializer, gate-level and row-level classifications

independenceBoundary.sharedWitnessInterpretation: shared frozen input/reachability regeneration only; not a representation or transition implementation

decisionRules.confirmed: A-G1 through A-G12 all PASS with exact zero mismatch where applicable
decisionRules.notConfirmed: A-G12 PASS and at least one mandatory semantic/binding gate A-G1 through A-G11 FAILS in an interpretable exact manner
decisionRules.nonEstimable: A-G12 FAILS, source identity drifts, reconstruction is incomplete, a technical/resource stop occurs, or another required exact comparison cannot be completed

noRescueFirewall: no replacement of stored rows by reconstructed rows as a correction of the upstream artifact
no raw identity-field change after outcome
no pending conservation-rule change after outcome
no reinterpretation of representation failure as a symmetry rejection
no Stage 2 candidate/applicability/population/depth/seed change after Stage 1 outcome
no independent-verifier alignment to production after outcome
no promotion of SIP diagnostic zero mismatches to ORISC formal evidence
interpretationBoundary: Stage 1 decides only whether the frozen repository representation/reconstruction contract is suitable as a downstream raw-state identity anchor under ORISC-STUDY1. It cannot alter the exact game-theoretic decision of REWR-STUDY1 or the closure of SIP-STUDY1.
